RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1792877655)

Repairs early CoinJoin roster validation when another saved account is an HD watch-only wallet. The account's HD inventory is now used while preserving ownership and unselected-input protections. Before the first accepted roster, participants show Awaiting validation instead of a misleading zero.

Includes earlier Lightning-wallet inventory, raw transaction fallback, welcome/replay/v4 compatibility and stopped-state reservation repairs, plus the existing wallet and artwork improvements.

CoinJoin remains Experimental. The exact physical-iPhone join failure still needs retesting. Required software, hosted iOS wallet/TLS and funded regtest checks passed for this app source; live CoinJoin and physical-device interoperability still require verification. If the previous failed participation remains listed, use Stop participation before starting a fresh attempt. Signed or uncertain reservations retain the displayed recovery requirements.

Review amounts, recipients and fees before signing. Mixing does not guarantee anonymity; the relay can see your IP and your backend can see address queries. Follow the displayed reservation and change recovery steps.
